note: Both sets draw the lighting-levels chart values from the page image and the Title 24 requirements from the text, but Set A binds them more cleanly and includes the vacancy-sensor/dimmer bypass requirement that Set B omits. Set B does capture the 40W/9W light-output equivalence that A misses, but it renders it as a misquote ('9W compact bulb' instead of '9W compact fluorescent bulb') and adds vague/trivial claims (light output 'same', incandescent bulb 40 W 'example') plus invented conditions such as 'per bulb', '4 bulbs', '6 bulbs'. Set B is also heavily redundant, repeating the same FC and bulb-count claims several times with inconsistent quote spellings (HIGH CONSTRAT/CONTRAST). On balance Set A is the more faithful and less padded extraction.
